projects.name: matchai
projects.description: Matchai is a modern life dashboard in development that aims to simplify the management of complex page setups by providing a view of all your routines and to-do’s at a glance. It eliminates the need for hours of setup by offering customizable pre-functioning “widgets” that cover everything from daily tasks, workouts, calendar events, mood logs, and more.

projects.name: wayvilo
projects.description: Wayvilo was a Washington Metro PWA that provided users a simple way to plan trips. It functioned similarly to the app, “Transit,” tailoring to WMATA’s system. It provided details such as trip directions, next train headways, and fare estimations, all in a clean, adless design. While the project has been discontinued, I am planning to develop another app for DC in the near future.

projects.name: pask
projects.description: Pask was my submission for the 2025 WWDC Student Swift Challenge, which aimed to teach the fundamentals of online security in an fun and engaging way. Inspired off of Duolingo's gamified design, users were challenged to secure a vault by completing quests. Users had to to redeem “key fragments” by completing security questions and gaining knowledge.
